stable.notes:
### Fixed
- **The Service Key guide is now readable without downloading it.** It shipped
  only as a release attachment, which GitHub hands you as a file rather than a
  page, and the in-app updater fetches just the binary: anyone who updated from
  the banner never got the guide at all. It is now published as a page you can
  open and send on, and the app links straight to it. The quick start is
  published the same way, and the download page now lists both instead of
  leaving them as attachments you had to notice.
